title.tr: Resmî dairede: edilgen, aktarma ve koşul
title.en: At the office: the passive, reporting and conditions

blocks.tr:
Bu bölümde **resmî yazıları** anlamayı öğreneceksin: apartman duyuruları, belediyeden gelen mektuplar, bir memurun söyledikleri. Üç şey yapabileceksin: edilgen cümleleri tanımak (*ενοικιάζεται*, *στάλθηκε*), **başkasının söylediğini ya da sorduğunu aktarmak** (*είπε ότι…*) ve koşul kurmak (*αν… θα…*). Sonunda cümleleri bağlaçlarla birleştirip 150 kelimelik bir metin yazmaya hazır olacaksın.

Anahtar nokta: edilgende işi yapan değil, **işin yapıldığı şey özne olur**. Türkçede de böyle: *yazıldı*, *gönderildi*, *kiralanır*.
blocks.en:
In this chapter you learn to understand **official writing**: building notices, letters from the town hall, what a clerk tells you. You will be able to recognise passive sentences (*ενοικιάζεται*, *στάλθηκε*), to **report what someone said or asked** (*είπε ότι…*) and to build conditions (*αν… θα…*). At the end you are ready to join sentences with linking words and write a 150-word text.

The key point: in the passive it is **the thing that receives the action that is the subject**, not the one who does it: "the letter was sent", "the flat is let".

blocks.tr: Bir devlet dairesinde sıra bekledin mi? Eve gelince arkadaşına *"dedi ki… sordu…"* diye anlattın. Bunu şimdi Yunanca yapacaksın.
blocks.en: Have you ever queued at an office? Afterwards you told a friend: "she said that… she asked…". Now you do that in Greek.

title.en: At the town hall, in the evening, and on the notice board

blocks.tr: Önce dinle, sonra oku. Üç şeye dikkat et: memurun cümleleri (*Φέρτε…*, *Θα είναι έτοιμο…*), Zeynep'in akşam anlatışı (*Μου είπε ότι…*) ve duyurudaki fiiller (*ενοικιάζεται*).
blocks.en: Listen first, then read. Watch three things: the clerk's sentences (*Φέρτε…*, *Θα είναι έτοιμο…*), Zeynep's retelling in the evening (*Μου είπε ότι…*) and the verbs on the notice (*ενοικιάζεται*).

setting.tr: Bir sabah belediyede. Zeynep memura "siz" diyor (εσείς).
setting.en: A morning at the town hall. Zeynep says "you" formally (εσείς) to the clerk.

lines.el: Καλημέρα σας. Παρακαλώ;
lines.tr: Günaydın. Buyurun?
lines.en: Good morning. Can I help you?

lines.el: Καλημέρα σας. Θέλω ένα πιστοποιητικό. Τι χρειάζομαι;
lines.tr: Günaydın. Bir belge istiyorum. Neye ihtiyacım var?
lines.en: Good morning. I would like a certificate. What do I need?

lines.el: Χρειάζεστε μια αίτηση. Το έντυπο είναι εδώ. Πού μένετε;
lines.tr: Bir başvuru gerekiyor. Form burada. Nerede oturuyorsunuz?
lines.en: You need an application. The form is here. Where do you live?

lines.el: Μένω στην Καλαμαριά.
lines.tr: Kalamarya'da oturuyorum.
lines.en: I live in Kalamaria.

lines.el: Δουλεύετε στη Θεσσαλονίκη;
lines.tr: Selanik'te mi çalışıyorsunuz?
lines.en: Do you work in Thessaloniki?

lines.el: Ναι, δουλεύω σε ένα φαρμακείο.
lines.tr: Evet, bir eczanede çalışıyorum.
lines.en: Yes, I work in a pharmacy.

lines.el: Πολύ καλά. Φέρτε την ταυτότητά σας και το έντυπο. Η προθεσμία είναι η Παρασκευή.
lines.tr: Çok iyi. Kimliğinizi ve formu getirin. Son tarih cuma.
lines.en: Very good. Bring your ID card and the form. The deadline is Friday.

lines.el: Και πότε θα είναι έτοιμο το πιστοποιητικό;
lines.tr: Peki belge ne zaman hazır olacak?
lines.en: And when will the certificate be ready?

lines.el: Θα είναι έτοιμο σε μια εβδομάδα. Αν δεν φέρετε την ταυτότητά σας, δεν θα πάρετε το πιστοποιητικό.
lines.tr: Bir hafta içinde hazır olacak. Kimliğinizi getirmezseniz belgeyi alamazsınız.
lines.en: It will be ready in a week. If you do not bring your ID card, you will not get the certificate.

lines.el: Ευχαριστώ πολύ.
lines.tr: Çok teşekkürler.
lines.en: Thank you very much.

picture_alt.tr: Belediyede: memur Zeynep'e formu veriyor; Zeynep kimliğini gösteriyor.
picture_alt.en: At the town hall: the clerk gives Zeynep the form; Zeynep shows her ID card.

blocks.tr: [[Παρακαλώ;]] burada "Buyurun, nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?" anlamında. Memur *εσείς* kullanıyor: *μένετε*, *δουλεύετε*, *χρειάζεστε*. [[Φέρτε]] "getirin" demek: resmî bir rica ya da emir, bunu tanıman yeter. [[σε μια εβδομάδα]] "bir hafta içinde, bir hafta sonra".
blocks.en: [[Παρακαλώ;]] here means "Can I help you?". The clerk uses *εσείς*: *μένετε*, *δουλεύετε*, *χρειάζεστε*. [[Φέρτε]] means "bring": a formal request, you only need to recognise it. [[σε μια εβδομάδα]] is "in a week".

setting.tr: Akşam. Zeynep, Giorgos'a memurun ne dediğini ve ne sorduğunu anlatıyor.
setting.en: Evening. Zeynep tells Giorgos what the clerk said and asked.

lines.el: Γεια σου, Ζεϊνέπ! Πώς πήγε στον δήμο;
lines.tr: Merhaba Zeynep! Belediyede nasıl geçti?
lines.en: Hi, Zeynep! How did it go at the town hall?

lines.el: Καλά! Η υπάλληλος ήταν πολύ καλή.
lines.tr: İyi! Memur çok iyiydi.
lines.en: Fine! The clerk was very nice.

lines.el: Τι σου είπε;
lines.tr: Sana ne dedi?
lines.en: What did she tell you?

lines.el: Μου είπε ότι χρειάζομαι μια αίτηση. Μου είπε επίσης να φέρω την ταυτότητά μου και το έντυπο.
lines.tr: Bir başvuru gerektiğini söyledi. Bir de kimliğimi ve formu getirmemi söyledi.
lines.en: She told me I need an application. She also told me to bring my ID card and the form.

lines.el: Και πότε θα είναι έτοιμο το πιστοποιητικό;
lines.tr: Peki belge ne zaman hazır olacak?
lines.en: And when will the certificate be ready?

lines.el: Είπε ότι θα είναι έτοιμο σε μια εβδομάδα. Με ρώτησε πού μένω και αν δουλεύω στη Θεσσαλονίκη.
lines.tr: Bir hafta içinde hazır olacağını söyledi. Nerede oturduğumu ve Selanik'te çalışıp çalışmadığımı sordu.
lines.en: She said it will be ready in a week. She asked me where I live and whether I work in Thessaloniki.

lines.el: Και τι είπες;
lines.tr: Sen ne dedin?
lines.en: And what did you say?

lines.el: Είπα ότι μένω στην Καλαμαριά και ότι δουλεύω σε ένα φαρμακείο.
lines.tr: Kalamarya'da oturduğumu ve bir eczanede çalıştığımı söyledim.
lines.en: I said that I live in Kalamaria and that I work in a pharmacy.

blocks.tr: Karşılaştır: memur «Πού μένετε;» dedi, Zeynep aktarırken *πού μένω* diyor. "Siz" "ben" oldu, ama zaman aynı kaldı. [[Πώς πήγε;]] "Nasıl geçti?" demek, şimdilik bir kalıp.
blocks.en: Compare: the clerk said «Πού μένετε;» and Zeynep reports *πού μένω*. "You" became "I", but the tense stayed. [[Πώς πήγε;]] means "How did it go?"; for now it is a set phrase.

setting.en: The notice board in the building's entrance.

lines.el: Το διαμέρισμα 4 ενοικιάζεται. Τηλεφωνήστε στον διαχειριστή.
lines.tr: 4 numaralı daire kiralık. Yöneticiyi arayın.
lines.en: Flat 4 is for rent. Call the manager.

lines.el: Το ασανσέρ επισκευάστηκε σήμερα.
lines.tr: Asansör bugün tamir edildi.
lines.en: The lift was repaired today.

lines.el: Οι κάτοικοι ενημερώνονται από τον διαχειριστή.
lines.tr: Sakinlere yönetici haber veriyor.
lines.en: The residents are informed by the manager.

blocks.tr: Duyuruda üç edilgen fiil var: *ενοικιάζεται* (kiralık), *επισκευάστηκε* (tamir edildi), *ενημερώνονται* (haber veriliyor). [[Τηλεφωνήστε]] "arayın" demek: duyurularda hep bu resmî emir biçimi kullanılır, tanıman yeter. [[επισκευάστηκε]] fiili *επισκευάζω* "tamir etmek" fiilinin edilgenidir.
blocks.en: The notice has three passive verbs: *ενοικιάζεται* (is for rent), *επισκευάστηκε* (was repaired), *ενημερώνονται* (are informed). [[Τηλεφωνήστε]] means "call": notices always use this formal request form, you only need to recognise it. [[επισκευάστηκε]] is the passive of *επισκευάζω* "to repair".

setting.tr: Giorgos, Zeynep'in kapısının altına bir not bırakıyor; Zeynep notun altına cevap yazıyor.
setting.en: Giorgos leaves a note under Zeynep's door; Zeynep writes her answer below it.

lines.el: Ζεϊνέπ, αν έχεις χρόνο το Σάββατο, θα πάμε μαζί στη βιβλιοθήκη.
lines.tr: Zeynep, cumartesi vaktin varsa birlikte kütüphaneye gideriz.
lines.en: Zeynep, if you have time on Saturday, we will go to the library together.

lines.el: Ευχαριστώ, Γιώργο! Αν δεν έχω μάθημα, θα έρθω.
lines.tr: Teşekkürler Giorgos! Dersim yoksa gelirim.
lines.en: Thanks, Giorgos! If I have no class, I will come.

picture_alt.tr: Cumartesi kütüphanede: Zeynep bir kitap okuyor; Giorgos raftan bir kitap alıyor.
picture_alt.en: Saturday at the library: Zeynep reads a book; Giorgos takes one from a shelf.

setting.tr: Zeynep, kütüphane kartı için resmî bir mektup yazıyor.
setting.en: Zeynep writes a formal letter about a library card.

lines.el: Αξιότιμε κύριε,
lines.tr: Sayın yetkili,
lines.en: Dear Sir,

lines.el: Με λένε Ζεϊνέπ και μένω στην Καλαμαριά. Γράφω επειδή θέλω μια κάρτα για τη βιβλιοθήκη.
lines.tr: Adım Zeynep, Kalamarya'da oturuyorum. Kütüphane için bir kart istediğim için yazıyorum.
lines.en: My name is Zeynep and I live in Kalamaria. I am writing because I would like a library card.

lines.el: Δουλεύω το πρωί, γι' αυτό μπορώ να έρθω μόνο το απόγευμα. Είναι ανοιχτή η βιβλιοθήκη το απόγευμα;
lines.tr: Sabahları çalışıyorum, bu yüzden ancak öğleden sonra gelebilirim. Kütüphane öğleden sonra açık mı?
lines.en: I work in the morning, so I can only come in the afternoon. Is the library open in the afternoon?

lines.el: Επίσης, χρειάζομαι ένα έντυπο; Αν ναι, θα το φέρω την Παρασκευή.
lines.tr: Ayrıca bir form gerekiyor mu? Gerekiyorsa cuma günü getiririm.
lines.en: Also, do I need a form? If so, I will bring it on Friday.

lines.el: Τέλος, ευχαριστώ πολύ για την απάντησή σας. Με εκτίμηση, Ζεϊνέπ.
lines.tr: Son olarak cevabınız için çok teşekkür ederim. Saygılarımla, Zeynep.
lines.en: Finally, thank you very much for your reply. Yours faithfully, Zeynep.

blocks.tr: [[Αξιότιμε κύριε]] resmî mektubun başlangıcı: "Sayın yetkili". [[μόνο]] "yalnızca". [[Με εκτίμηση]] resmî mektubun sonu: "Saygılarımla". [[Τέλος]] "son olarak". [[την απάντησή σας]] "cevabınızı".
blocks.en: [[Αξιότιμε κύριε]] opens a formal letter: "Dear Sir". [[μόνο]] "only". [[Με εκτίμηση]] closes it: "Yours faithfully". [[Τέλος]] "finally". [[την απάντησή σας]] "your reply".

blocks.tr:
Etken cümlede işi yapan özne olur: *Ο διαχειριστής γράφει το έντυπο.* Edilgen cümlede işin yapıldığı şey özne olur: *Το έντυπο γράφεται.* Yani "form doldurulur". İşi yapanı söylemek istersen **από** + isim kullanırsın: *από τον διαχειριστή*.

**Şimdiki zaman:** fiil kökünün sonuna **-εται** (bir şey) ya da **-ονται** (birkaç şey) eklenir: *γράφ-εται*, *γράφ-ονται*. Burada 3. kişi yeterli.

**Geçmiş zaman:** tek kelime, **-τηκε / -θηκε** (çoğulda **-τηκαν / -θηκαν**): *γράφτηκε*, *στάλθηκε*. Her fiilin biçimini fiille birlikte öğren; şu kalıplar yardım eder: *-φω → -φτηκε*, *-ζω → -στηκε*, *-νω → -θηκε*. *στέλνω → στάλθηκε* düzensiz.

**πωλείται** (satılık) levhalardaki biçimdir; olduğu gibi öğren.
blocks.en:
In an active sentence the doer is the subject: *Ο διαχειριστής γράφει το έντυπο.* In a passive sentence the thing that receives the action is the subject: *Το έντυπο γράφεται.* "The form is filled in." To name the doer, use **από** + a noun: *από τον διαχειριστή*.

**Present:** add **-εται** (one thing) or **-ονται** (several) to the verb's stem: *γράφ-εται*, *γράφ-ονται*. The third person is enough here.

**Past (aorist):** one word, ending **-τηκε / -θηκε** (plural **-τηκαν / -θηκαν**): *γράφτηκε*, *στάλθηκε*. Learn each verb's form with the verb; these patterns help: *-φω → -φτηκε*, *-ζω → -στηκε*, *-νω → -θηκε*. *στέλνω → στάλθηκε* is irregular.

**πωλείται** (for sale) is the form on signs; learn it as it is.

note.tr: Aynı kalıp: ενοικιάζω → ενοικιάζεται, επισκευάζω → επισκευάστηκε.
note.en: The same pattern: ενοικιάζω → ενοικιάζεται, επισκευάζω → επισκευάστηκε.

items.el: Το πιστοποιητικό στάλθηκε από τον δήμο.
items.en: The certificate was sent by the town hall.
The forms are filled in here.

title.en: Reported speech: είπε ότι…, ρώτησε αν…

blocks.tr:
Birinin söylediğini aktarırken dört kalıp var:

**Düz cümle:** *είπε* **ότι** + aynı zaman. «Θα είναι έτοιμο.» → *Είπε ότι θα είναι έτοιμο.* İngilizcedeki *would* kayması Yunancada genellikle yok: gelecek gelecek, şimdiki şimdiki kalır.

**Evet/hayır sorusu:** *ρώτησε* **αν** + soru. «Δουλεύετε εδώ;» → *Με ρώτησε αν δουλεύω εδώ.*

**Soru sözcüklü soru:** *ρώτησε* + aynı soru sözcüğü (*πού*, *πότε*, *τι*). «Πού μένετε;» → *Με ρώτησε πού μένω.* Soru işareti kalkar.

**Rica ya da emir:** *μου είπε* **να** + tamamlanmış (aorist kökü) biçim: *θέλω να* sözünden tanıdığın biçim. «Φέρτε το έντυπο.» → *Μου είπε να φέρω το έντυπο.*

Kişiler değişir: memurun «siz» dediği, aktarırken «ben» olur.
blocks.en:
There are four patterns for reporting:

**A statement:** *είπε* **ότι** + the same tense. «Θα είναι έτοιμο.» → *Είπε ότι θα είναι έτοιμο.* The English "would" shift is usually absent in Greek: a future stays a future, a present stays a present.

**A yes/no question:** *ρώτησε* **αν** + the question. «Δουλεύετε εδώ;» → *Με ρώτησε αν δουλεύω εδώ.*

**A question with a question word:** *ρώτησε* + the same word (*πού*, *πότε*, *τι*). «Πού μένετε;» → *Με ρώτησε πού μένω.* The question mark goes.

**A request or an order:** *μου είπε* **να** + the perfective form you know from *θέλω να*. «Φέρτε το έντυπο.» → *Μου είπε να φέρω το έντυπο.*

The persons change: the clerk's "you" becomes "I" when Zeynep reports.

rows: Είπε ότι θα είναι έτοιμο σε μια εβδομάδα.
Με ρώτησε αν δουλεύω στη Θεσσαλονίκη.
Μου είπε να φέρω την ταυτότητά μου.

items.el: Ο Γιώργος είπε ότι θα έρθει αύριο.
items.en: Giorgos said he would come tomorrow.

items.el: Η Σοφία με ρώτησε πότε φεύγω.
items.en: Sofia asked me when I am leaving.

items.el: Ο διαχειριστής μας είπε ότι το ασανσέρ είναι κλειστό.
items.tr: Yönetici bize asansörün kapalı olduğunu söyledi.
items.en: The manager told us that the lift is closed.

items.el: Η υπάλληλος μου είπε να περιμένω.
items.en: The clerk told me to wait.

blocks.tr:
**αν** "eğer" demek. Cümlenin iki yarısı var: *αν* ile kurulan koşul ve *θα* ile kurulan sonuç. Sonuç yarısı gelecek zamandır, yani **θα + tamamlanmış kök**: *θα πάμε*, *θα σου τηλεφωνήσω*.

Koşul cümlesinde *αν* sözünden sonra **θα gelmez**. Fiil iki biçimden birinde olur:
- **şimdiki zaman**, bir durum için: *αν έχεις χρόνο*;
- **θέλω να sözünden tanıdığın tamamlanmış biçim**, tek bir olay için: *αν έρθεις*, *αν φύγω*.

Olumsuz için *δεν*: *αν δεν φέρετε*.
blocks.en:
**αν** means "if". The sentence has two halves: the *αν* part (the condition) and the *θα* part (the result). The result is a future: **θα + the perfective stem**: *θα πάμε*, *θα σου τηλεφωνήσω*.

**In a condition, αν is never followed by θα.** The verb is in one of two forms:
- the **present**, for a state: *αν έχεις χρόνο*;
- the **perfective form you know from θέλω να**, for a single event: *αν έρθεις*, *αν φύγω*.

For "not" use *δεν*: *αν δεν φέρετε*.

head: αν …
θα …
rows: Αν δεν φέρετε την ταυτότητά σας,

items.el: Αν δεν έχω μάθημα, θα έρθω στη βιβλιοθήκη.
items.en: If I have no class, I will come to the library.

items.el: Αν βρω εισιτήριο, θα ταξιδέψω αύριο.
items.en: If I find a ticket, I will travel tomorrow.

items.el: Αν είναι ανοιχτό το περίπτερο, θα αγοράσω εφημερίδα.
items.en: If the kiosk is open, I will buy a newspaper.

blocks.tr: B1 metni kısa cümlelerden oluşan bir liste değil, birbirine bağlı bir metindir. Altı küçük kelime işini görür: nedeni, sonucu, karşıtlığı ya da sırayı gösterirler.
blocks.en: A B1 text is not a list of short sentences but a text whose parts are joined. Six small words do the job: they show the reason, the result, a contrast or the order.

rows: Δουλεύω κοντά, γι' αυτό πηγαίνω με τα πόδια.

rows.en: while, whereas (two things side by side)

rows: Ενώ η Ζεϊνέπ δουλεύει, ο Γιώργος κοιμάται.

note.tr: γι' αυτό yazılışı: kesme işareti var, *για αυτό* sözünün kısası.
note.en: Spelling of γι' αυτό: with an apostrophe, short for *για αυτό*.

blocks.tr: Bu bölümün kelimeleri: resmî daire kelimeleri, iki fiil ve bağlaçlar. Bölümü bitirince oturumlarına gelecekler.
blocks.en: The words of this chapter: office words, two verbs and the linking words. Once you finish the chapter they come into your sessions.

blocks.tr: **Edilgen Türkçedekiyle aynı mantık.** *γράφτηκε* = *yazıldı*, *στάλθηκε* = *gönderildi*, *πληρώθηκε* = *ödendi*. Türkçede fiile *-il-* ya da *-in-* eklersin; Yunancada fiil değişir ve **tek bir kelime** olur. Aktarmada da benzerlik var: Türkçede *"cuma günü hazır olacak, dedi"* gelecek zamanı korur, Yunanca *είπε ότι θα είναι έτοιμο* da öyle.
blocks.en: **The passive works as in Turkish.** *γράφτηκε* = Turkish *yazıldı*, *στάλθηκε* = *gönderildi*. Turkish adds *-il-* or *-in-* to the verb; Greek changes the verb and it stays **one word**. In reported speech Greek *είπε ότι θα είναι έτοιμο* keeps the future, where English changes it to "would be".

blocks.tr: **Koşulda αν sözünden sonra θα yok.** *Αν θα έρθεις, θα πάμε* yanlış. Doğrusu: *Αν έρθεις, θα πάμε μαζί.* *θα* yalnızca sonuç yarısına girer. Dolaylı soruda ise *αν* "-ip -mediğini" demektir ve ardından *θα* gelebilir: [[Με ρώτησε αν θα έρθω.]]
blocks.en: **No θα after αν in a condition.** *Αν θα έρθεις, θα πάμε* is wrong. Say: *Αν έρθεις, θα πάμε μαζί.* *θα* goes only in the result. In a reported question, though, *αν* means "whether" and can take *θα*: [[Με ρώτησε αν θα έρθω.]]

blocks.tr: **ότι mi, να mı?** Bir bilgiyi aktarırken *ότι*: *Μου είπε ότι χρειάζομαι αίτηση.* Bir rica ya da emri aktarırken *να*: *Μου είπε να φέρω το έντυπο.* İkisini karıştırma.
blocks.en: **ότι or να?** To report a fact use *ότι*: *Μου είπε ότι χρειάζομαι αίτηση.* To report a request or an order use *να*: *Μου είπε να φέρω το έντυπο.* Do not mix them.

blocks.tr: B1 sınavının resmî yazısı yaklaşık 150 kelimedir (sınav planında 130–170) ve bir istek, başvuru ya da şikâyet ister; nedenlerini de söylemelisin. Zeynep'in mektubu iskeleti gösteriyor: (1) *Αξιότιμε κύριε / Αξιότιμη κυρία*, (2) kim olduğun ve neden yazdığın (*επειδή*), (3) bir ya da iki ayrıntı ya da soru (*επίσης*, *όμως*, *γι' αυτό*), (4) *Τέλος* ile teşekkür, (5) *Με εκτίμηση*. Kısa cümleleri arka arkaya dizme; bağlaç kullan.
blocks.en: The formal text in the B1 exam is about 150 words (the exam plan lists 130–170) and asks for a request, an application or a complaint, with reasons. Zeynep's letter shows the frame: (1) *Αξιότιμε κύριε / Αξιότιμη κυρία*, (2) who you are and why you write (*επειδή*), (3) one or two details or questions (*επίσης*, *όμως*, *γι' αυτό*), (4) thanks, introduced by *Τέλος*, (5) *Με εκτίμηση*. Do not line up short sentences; join them with linking words.

blocks.tr: Şimdi sen dene. Yanlış yapmak serbest: bunlar sınav hazırlığı hesabına girmez.
blocks.en: Now you try. Mistakes are fine here: these do not count towards your exam readiness.
